instruction:
Image collection task. Read .relay/tasks/canon-images/canon.json (37 canonical magazine designs, each with a source url).
For each item: open its url (and, if that page has no images of the work, use web search to find a documenting page that does). Download up to 2 images that show the actual cover or spreads (not logos, portraits or ads), largest available version, max 2 MB each, jpg/png/webp only.
Save them as .relay/tasks/canon-images/img/NN-<short-slug>-<k>.<ext> where NN is the item's 1-based index in canon.json.
Write .relay/tasks/canon-images/images.json: a list of {"index": NN, "publication": ..., "issue": ..., "file": relative path or null, "image_url": ..., "source_page": ..., "shows": "cover|spread|page|other"}. If nothing could be downloaded for an item, add one entry with file null and a short reason.
Do not touch files outside .relay/tasks/canon-images/. Final message: counts only (items with images, total files, failures), under 600 characters.
